plugin.name: preserve-output
plugin._long: A plugin to restore windows to their original position if outputs are temporarily disconnected. When an output is disconnected, its windows are moved to a connected output so that they remain accessible, and they are moved back to the output where they were placed when it is reconnected.

option.name: last_output_focus_timeout
option._long: Length of time in milliseconds to remember a destroyed output as the last output with focus, before it can be overridden by another destroyed output with focus.
